pricing_strategies.name: Customized Pricing (Bid-Response)
pricing_strategies.description: Setting individualized B2B prices based on bid-response models and incremental profit.
pricing_strategies.best_for: High-value, low-volume transactions with heterogeneous buyers
pricing_strategies.avoid_when: Commodity markets with transparent, uniform pricing
pricing_strategies.customer_psychology: Perceived as negotiated partnership rather than fixed markup

legal_compliance.restrictions: Cannot discriminate among competing retailers without cost-justification

ab_testing_guidelines.test_duration: Ongoing A/B testing of discount thresholds

pricing_strategies.name: Nonlinear Pricing (Two-Part Tariffs)
pricing_strategies.description: Charging a fixed access fee plus a per-unit usage fee to capture consumer surplus.
pricing_strategies.best_for: Services with high fixed costs and low marginal costs
pricing_strategies.avoid_when: Usage is impossible to meter or track
pricing_strategies.customer_psychology: Fixed fee perceived as 'membership', usage fee as 'fair pay for value'

risks: Customer churn due to fixed fees

legal_compliance.restrictions: Must not engage in anti-competitive bundling
legal_compliance.disclosure_requirements: Clear breakdown of access vs. usage costs

exit_strategy.how_to_unwind: Shift to flat-rate or pure pay-per-use

pricing_strategies.name: Price Bundling
pricing_strategies.description: Selling multiple products/services together at a discount to extract surplus and reduce costs.
pricing_strategies.target_segment: Customers with negatively correlated valuations for components
pricing_strategies.best_for: Information goods, software, travel packages
pricing_strategies.avoid_when: Customers strongly prefer à la carte or components have highly correlated valuations
pricing_strategies.customer_psychology: Transaction utility: Perceived savings lower price sensitivity; mental accounting

legal_compliance.restrictions: Cannot force purchase of secondary product as condition for monopolized primary

common_pitfalls: Failing to offer à la carte escape hatch

exit_strategy.how_to_unwind: Revert to à la carte pricing

pricing_strategies.name: Unbundling & Versioning
pricing_strategies.description: Separating ancillary services or intentionally degrading quality to segment markets.
pricing_strategies.best_for: Digital goods, services with high fixed costs
pricing_strategies.avoid_when: Customers demand all-inclusive experience
pricing_strategies.customer_psychology: Base price anchoring; loss aversion to unbundled fees

legal_compliance.restrictions: No drip pricing or hidden mandatory fees
legal_compliance.disclosure_requirements: Total price including mandatory fees must be clear

common_pitfalls: Product damaging that breaks core UX

pricing_strategies.name: Markdown Management
pricing_strategies.description: Clearing seasonal or perishable inventory via dynamic, time-based price reductions.
pricing_strategies.best_for: Short lifecycle, high obsolescence risk
pricing_strategies.avoid_when: Selling timeless classics or luxury exclusivity
pricing_strategies.customer_psychology: Reference price formation; strategic waiting for discounts

legal_compliance.restrictions: Cannot advertise 'was' price if never sold at that price

exit_strategy.how_to_unwind: Shift to EDLP or high-low promo

cross_sell_opportunities: Clearance as loss leaders for full-margin accessories

pricing_strategies.name: Reference Price Modeling
pricing_strategies.description: Pricing based on consumer memory of past prices, exploiting gain/loss asymmetry.
pricing_strategies.best_for: Frequently purchased goods with regular promotions
pricing_strategies.avoid_when: New product launches or highly commoditized goods
pricing_strategies.customer_psychology: Prospect theory: Loss aversion (p > r) vs. Gain seeking (p < r)

legal_compliance.restrictions: Must not use fake reference prices
legal_compliance.disclosure_requirements: Accurate MSRP or regular price display

pricing_strategies.name: Trade & Sales Promotions
pricing_strategies.description: Incentives (off-invoice, scan-back, accrual) to stimulate channel and retail sales.
pricing_strategies.best_for: Launching new products, clearing excess inventory
pricing_strategies.avoid_when: Highly commoditized markets with thin margins
pricing_strategies.customer_psychology: Channel partners motivated by margin enhancement and volume bonuses

legal_compliance.restrictions: Must offer proportional allowances to competing retailers

pricing_strategies.name: Network Revenue Management
pricing_strategies.description: Controlling capacity across multiple interconnected resources (e.g., airline hubs).
pricing_strategies.best_for: Hub-and-spoke networks, multi-leg itineraries
pricing_strategies.avoid_when: Point-to-point single-resource models
pricing_strategies.customer_psychology: Opaque pricing; customers accept restrictions for lower fares

legal_compliance.restrictions: Cannot use protected classes for rate fences

pricing_strategies.name: Auction Pricing
pricing_strategies.description: Eliciting buyer valuations via mechanisms like Vickrey, GSP, or Combinatorial auctions.
pricing_strategies.best_for: Unique items, perishable ad inventory, spectrum licenses
pricing_strategies.avoid_when: Standardized goods with established market prices
pricing_strategies.customer_psychology: Competitive arousal; strategic bid shading to avoid winner's curse

legal_compliance.restrictions: No shill bidding or bid rigging
legal_compliance.disclosure_requirements: Clear auction rules and reserve prices

exit_strategy.how_to_unwind: Shift to fixed-price or negotiated sales

pricing_strategies.name: Services Engineering (Real Options)
pricing_strategies.description: Offering callable, flexible, or upgrade options to manage capacity and segment risk.
pricing_strategies.best_for: Perishable capacity with heterogeneous flexibility
pricing_strategies.avoid_when: Standardized, non-perishable goods
pricing_strategies.customer_psychology: Value of flexibility; risk premium for guaranteed fulfillment

legal_compliance.restrictions: Must honor compensation terms for recalled services

pricing_strategies.name: Buy-Back Contracts
pricing_strategies.description: Manufacturer repurchases unsold inventory to share downside risk and coordinate channel.
pricing_strategies.best_for: High obsolescence risk, short lifecycle products
pricing_strategies.avoid_when: Low margin, stable demand commodities
pricing_strategies.customer_psychology: Risk mitigation; encourages higher initial orders

legal_compliance.restrictions: Must comply with return/disposal laws

exit_strategy.how_to_unwind: Shift to revenue sharing or wholesale price

pricing_strategies.name: Revenue Sharing Contracts
pricing_strategies.description: Retailer shares a percentage of sales revenue with the manufacturer in exchange for lower wholesale price.
pricing_strategies.best_for: Products where retail effort drives demand
pricing_strategies.avoid_when: Sales are difficult to track or verify
pricing_strategies.customer_psychology: Retailer motivated by higher margin per unit and lower risk

legal_compliance.restrictions: Must ensure accurate reporting

pricing_strategies.name: Quantity Flexibility Contracts
pricing_strategies.description: Allowing order modification within limits after demand realization to balance risk.
pricing_strategies.target_segment: Supply chains with high forecast uncertainty
pricing_strategies.best_for: High fixed costs, volatile demand environments
pricing_strategies.avoid_when: Rigid, inflexible manufacturing processes
pricing_strategies.customer_psychology: Risk reduction; encourages higher initial commitments

legal_compliance.restrictions: Must define modification limits clearly

pricing_strategies.name: Capacity Reservation & Payback
pricing_strategies.description: Manufacturer pays for reserved capacity or receives payback for unused capacity to align incentives.
pricing_strategies.target_segment: Upstream suppliers with high capacity costs
pricing_strategies.best_for: Critical components with long leadtimes and high capacity costs
pricing_strategies.avoid_when: Commodity components with abundant capacity
pricing_strategies.customer_psychology: Security of supply; shared investment burden

legal_compliance.restrictions: Must not create exclusive dealing violations

pricing_strategies.name: Advance Selling
pricing_strategies.description: Selling before the season to acquire demand information and manage capacity.
pricing_strategies.best_for: Products with high capacity costs and uncertain demand
pricing_strategies.avoid_when: Highly volatile demand with no learning effect
pricing_strategies.customer_psychology: Value of early access; risk premium for guaranteed availability

mitigation_strategies: Use advance selling for information only

legal_compliance.restrictions: Must deliver as promised
legal_compliance.disclosure_requirements: Clear delivery dates and refund policies

common_pitfalls: Failing to use info for production

pricing_strategies.name: Behavioral Framing (Loss Aversion)
pricing_strategies.description: Presenting prices as discounts vs. surcharges to exploit prospect theory and gain/loss asymmetry.
pricing_strategies.best_for: Payment methods, loyalty programs, promotional offers
pricing_strategies.avoid_when: Highly regulated industries (e.g., credit card surcharges)
pricing_strategies.customer_psychology: Prospect theory: Losses loom larger than gains; framing effects

risks: Customer anger if perceived as deceptive

legal_compliance.restrictions: Cannot frame mandatory fees as optional discounts

pricing_strategies.name: Game-Theoretic Pricing
pricing_strategies.description: Anticipating competitor responses to avoid price wars and optimize strategic positioning.
pricing_strategies.best_for: Oligopolistic markets, repeated interactions
pricing_strategies.avoid_when: Highly fragmented, perfect competition markets
pricing_strategies.customer_psychology: N/A (B2B/Strategic focus)

legal_compliance.restrictions: No explicit collusion or price fixing

pricing_strategies.name: Pan-Local Global Pricing
pricing_strategies.description: Harmonizing global strategy with local market conditions, currency, and cultural norms.
pricing_strategies.best_for: Multinational companies with diverse regional markets
pricing_strategies.avoid_when: Purely domestic or highly commoditized global goods
pricing_strategies.customer_psychology: Local value perception; cultural pricing norms (e.g., negotiation vs. fixed)

legal_compliance.restrictions: Must comply with local pricing regulations

resource_requirements.team_size: Global Pricing, Finance, Legal, Regional GMs

pricing_strategies.name: Lean Six Sigma Pricing Execution
pricing_strategies.description: Reducing pricing defects (e.g., unauthorized discounts) via DMAIC to improve margin realization.
pricing_strategies.best_for: Companies with high pricing defect rates and decentralized execution
pricing_strategies.avoid_when: Companies needing strategic pricing transformation
pricing_strategies.customer_psychology: Internal focus; changes sales behavior and accountability

legal_compliance.restrictions: Must maintain accurate financial reporting

resource_requirements.team_size: Master Black Belt, Pricing, Sales, IT

pricing_strategies.name: Overbooking Strategies
pricing_strategies.description: Selling beyond capacity to hedge against cancellations and no-shows, maximizing utilization.
pricing_strategies.best_for: Perishable capacity with predictable cancellation rates
pricing_strategies.avoid_when: High cost of denied service or severe reputational risk
pricing_strategies.customer_psychology: Risk of denied service; requires robust compensation and recovery

legal_compliance.restrictions: Must compensate denied service per regulations

lean_six_sigma_dmaic.purpose: Improve pricing execution and reduce 'defects' (e.g., unauthorized discounts, margin leakage).

dmaic_process.define: Identify pricing defects and set financial goals.
dmaic_process.analyze: Root-cause analysis (Fishbone/C&E Matrix), statistical analysis of price variation.
dmaic_process.improve: Implement graduated discount authority, exception tracking codes.
dmaic_process.control: Monthly price review meetings, dashboard metrics, sustain controls.

b2b_contract_coordination.purpose: Align incentives and share risks/profits in decentralized supply chains.

contract_types.buy_back: Manufacturer repurchases unsold inventory to share downside risk.
contract_types.revenue_sharing: Retailer shares sales revenue for lower wholesale price.
contract_types.quantity_flexibility: Allows order modification within limits after demand realization.
contract_types.capacity_reservation: Manufacturer pays for reserved capacity to ensure supply.

global_pan_local_strategy.purpose: Harmonize global brand strategy with local market realities.

components.currency_hedging: Reduce exchange rate volatility without distorting local price positioning.
components.cultural_negotiation: Adapt pricing structures to local norms (e.g., negotiation vs. fixed).
components.gray_market_control: Prevent arbitrage through regional product differentiation and channel control.

behavioral_economics_integration.purpose: Leverage cognitive biases to optimize pricing presentation and promotions.

concepts.prospect_theory: Loss aversion; frame prices as discounts vs. surcharges.
concepts.reference_pricing: Manage consumer memory of past prices via promo frequency/depth control.
concepts.framing_effects: Present bundles and tariffs to maximize perceived transaction utility.

startup.rationale: Focus on customer acquisition, cash flow, and execution discipline

growth_stage.rationale: Optimize revenue per customer and segment market

mature_enterprise.rationale: Maximize margins, defend market position, and coordinate global supply chains

pricing_committee.meeting_frequency: Monthly for strategic, Weekly for tactical/execution defects

approval_workflow.moderate_changes: Pricing Committee approval (5-15% change or B2B contract exceptions)
approval_workflow.major_changes: Executive Committee approval (>15% change or new RM model)
approval_workflow.strategic_changes: Board notification (>30% change or global pricing overhaul)

optimization_cycle: Collect data and insights (POS, ERP, CRM, Scanner panels)
Analyze performance and opportunities (Econometric modeling, Game theory)
Hypothesize improvements (Behavioral & Nonlinear pricing, B2B contracts)
Design and run experiments (A/B testing, Pilot regions)
Implement winners (System updates, Training, DMAIC controls)
